Description
This is a genuine American Eagle Silver Bullion coin minted and issued by the United States Mint as part of a collaboration with Nice Gang’s game Eighth Era to introduce and welcome gamers to the wonderful world of coin collecting.
These coins are 99.9% silver, include enhanced security features and have a limited mintage of 500,000. They are also the first bullion coins to feature a privy mark. Coupled with Nice Gang’s revolutionary rewards system offering real-life rewards for in-game achievements, these coins have the potential to bridge the gap between generations of coin collectors and their gaming friends and family. These coins are not available directly from the United States Mint but may be won, earned, or bought from Nice Gang or purchased from the Mint’s network of Authorized Purchasers of bullion coins and the secondary market.
Design of 1 oz Star Privy American Silver Eagle Coin
These classic American coins were redesigned in 2021 to feature an updated obverse (heads side) design, an all-new reverse (tails side) design and additional anti-counterfeiting security features including a variable reeded-edge. These coins also feature a Star Privy Mark, the first privy mark ever used on a bullion coin, making these coins a truly unique addition to any collection.
The obverse (heads side) design is based on legendary sculptor Adolph A. Weinman’s 1916 Walking Liberty Half Dollar, widely considered one of the most beautiful American coins ever minted. Updated in 2021, the obverse now offers a closer reflection of Weinman’s original vision on the obverse including the addition of histraditional artist’s mark. The redesigned reverse (tails side) features an eagle as it approaches a landing, carrying an oak branch, as if to add to a nest.
Obverse Inscriptions: LIBERTY; IN GOD WE TRUST; YEAR; Artist’s Initials, Star Privy Mark
Reverse Inscriptions: UNITED STATES OF AMERICA; E PLURIBUS UNUM; 1 OZ. FINE SILVER; ONE DOLLAR
